item.title: Replace string order statuses with OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate so order status is represented by a proper enum while preserving observable behavior. Add src/status.rs with public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) -> &'static str returning the lowercase spellings, Display with the same output, FromStr<Err = ParseStatusError>, and a public ParseStatusError implementing std::error::Error whose message names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to with exactly these allowed transitions: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at the crate root, and replace status-string comparisons/usages throughout the crate so the lowercase status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Existing externally observable behavior remains exactly the same, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing behavior.
- The status name string literals appear only in src/status.rs.
- Add/update tests as needed and run cargo test successfully.
- Commit the completed change.

stages.summary: Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal: introduce public OrderStatus/ParseStatusError, change Order::status to the enum, and replace status strings while preserving behavior; the only stated contract change is the status representation/type itself. Original baseline is 00b1567aca58b69c0b2f50a276c92a02533471ac. Added integration characterization tests in tests/orders.rs and committed them separately as 08695fa0ecb76ce86e8bfffa7b035b8ce1ed212c; worktree is clean. Baseline checks before edits: with the item CARGO_TARGET_DIR, cargo test passed (3 integration tests), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed, cargo check passed, and cargo fmt -- --check failed because existing src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs, and tests/orders.rs are not rustfmt formatted. After adding tests, cargo test passed (5 integration tests), clippy and check passed, and fmt check still fails on pre-existing production formatting plus the old test formatting; new tests were rustfmt formatted. The last full check tree is 54f897c773ff9be271badeae7b251e155a17ee9a. Public surface: crate-root Order; public modules billing (pay, outstanding_cents), order (Order fields, new, is_open, cancel), report (status_counts, to_line, from_line), shipping (ship, ready_to_ship). Order's public id/customer/total_cents/status fields make the status type and display directly observable. Report CSV shape/order, validation order and exact errors, status_counts sorted by lexical status, lifecycle errors and returned IDs/totals are contracts to preserve. No CLI or wire interface beyond report CSV exists. Coverage now pins lifecycle plus failed ship/pay, cancel from pending/paid and repeated cancel, report count ordering and round trip, field-count/id/total/status error strings, rejected mixed case, and whole-line trim behavior (including untrimmed customer field). Remaining thin coverage for refactorer: no explicit exact assertions for bad numeric overflow, too many CSV fields, or every failed operation/status pairing; no contract exception for those is granted. No feedback was provided.
